0.original: Seto would make a personal request of you.

48.original: Urianger tells me you've been busy trying to win Seto over, and I agree that you're the best <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> for the job. A silver tongue can only get one so far.

49.original: I heard a fearsome roar... Is everything all right?

50.original: Whatever Seto hath in store for thee, I wish thee godsspeed.

51.original: This is not a test of your strength, but a personal request. Please hear my tale.

52.original: A while ago, I fought sin eaters who had wandered into Il Mheg. In the heat of battle, I dropped a prized possession─a medallion. Of all the places that it should fall, it was Longmirror Lake.

53.original: We amaro are not fond of water─we certainly cannot dive very deep. I briefly entertained the thought of turning to the Fuath, but they are more likely to keep my medallion out of mischief than return it to me.

54.original: I had despaired of retrieving my treasure, but having seen what you are capable of, perhaps you will be able to find it.

55.original: While I ponder your request for the shoes, will you not go and search for my medallion? If it should elude even you, I will accept that it is gone forever.

56.original: As I recall, I was above the waters west of the castle when I dropped the medallion. I wish you luck.

57.original: This does not appear to be Seto's medallion.
